sample_unit: clinician users of the AI-powered EHR search and clinical discovery tool

links.outcome: Adoption, user satisfaction and perceived time saved after user-centered rollout with feedback incorporation
links.effect: 163/176 (93%) users adopted the AI features after 3 months; user satisfaction (U=49; P<.001) and perception of time saved (U=49; P<.001) increased significantly.
links.quote: High adoption rates and positive user experiences were driven by our user-centered research program, which emphasized close collaboration with users, rapid incorporation of feedback, and tailored user training.

screen.practice: user-centered implementation program (feedback incorporation, tailored training)
screen.reason: Empirical mixed-methods study evaluating the real-world deployment of an AI-powered EHR search tool using a user-centered design and deployment approach (tailored training and rapid feedback integration).

primary.practice: user-centered deployment with tailored user training and feedback incorporation
